Ingredients in Rush Herbal Popper prices

• Ingredients per 3 ml: water, 39 mg L-arginine, 39 mg Siberian ginseng (Eleutherococcus senticosus), 39 mg saw palmetto (Serenoa repens), 39 mg cranberry (Vaccinium macrocarpon), 15 mg Ginkgo biloba, 15 mg L-glutamic acid, 15 mg L-alanine, 15 mg L-lysine, 15 mg NE* niacin (as nicotinamide) (=83% RI**), sodium chloride, preservatives: E211, E202. *NE = Niacin equivalent. **RI = Reference intake.
